**Client mutations:** use `createEnvironmentRpcCommand`. Add protected methods to `CLIENT_GUARDED_RPC_SCOPES`, use the command’s `permissionAtom` for availability, and extend permission behaviour tests. Execution checks grants against the destination environment; the server stays authoritative. Raw RPC clients stay inside `rpc/`.

passage: When upstream covers part of a capability, use its implementation plus the smallest fork extension. Two complete implementations of one thing need a recorded reason and exit condition.
existing: **Comments:** default to none. Record only a constraint, external quirk or invariant the code cannot show, usually one line, at most four. Do not narrate code, signatures or fix history; `t3code/no-low-value-comments` enforces the mechanical cases.
